_note: The Drowned Vault (hidden dungeon under Mirefen, levels 24-26; owner: mirefen).

regions.name: Drowned Stair
regions.text: The Drowned Vault — a fen temple that sank with all its lanterns lit. Water whispers down the walls, always downward.

regions.name: Heart-Well
regions.text: The Heart-Well. Drowned lanterns lie heaped round a black pool that drains away into the deep — towards something that beats.

creatures.name: Drowned Thrall
creatures.description: A fen-folk sexton, a pilgrim, a lamplighter — whoever the undertow caught. The water keeps them walking.

creatures.name: Tide Wisp
creatures.description: A drowned lantern's light, gone cold and green and spiteful in the dark water.

creatures.name: Tide Spark
creatures.description: A spark of the Tidewitch's pool.

creatures.name: Drowned Sentinel
creatures.description: A temple guard in verdigris bronze, still keeping the vault's doors a hundred years after the water came in. Barnacles to the eyebrows.

creatures.name: Sentinel-Captain Ossuary
creatures.description: The vault guard's captain, wearing the drowned temple's last banner as a cloak. His orders were to let no one in. He has expanded them.
creatures.bark: *The captain's porthole visor brightens. Bubbles rise from inside it, slowly.*

creatures.name: Vault Snapjaw
creatures.description: A crocolisk that swam down the undertow as an egg and grew up in the dark. Pale, huge and blind, and it does not need to see you.

creatures.name: The Tidewitch
creatures.description: Mother Mire's sister from under the sea-road, who drinks the drowned lanterns' light and sends it down the undertow to the Hollow Heart. She hums while she works. It is a lullaby, and it is not for you.
creatures.bark: Shh, shh. Little lights go down, down, down. And so will you, my dears. So will you.

abilities.name: Trident Sweep
abilities.description: A wide sweep of the barnacled trident hits up to 3 enemies in front for weapon damage plus {0}.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: A drag of cold water pulls the sentinel to the target and roots it for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Barnacle Guard
abilities.description: Hunches into its barnacled plate: armor increased by 60% for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Drowned Grasp
abilities.description: Cold, wet hands: weapon damage, and the target is chilled for 9 sec.

abilities.name: Tide Bolt
abilities.description: A bolt of black seawater: {0} Frost damage.

abilities.name: Rip Current
abilities.description: The water around the target spins: knocked back and slowed for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.description: The captain bangs his trident on the stone. Nearby allies take 15% less damage for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Vault Bite
abilities.description: A bite from a jaw that has grown up in the dark: weapon damage plus {0}.

abilities.name: Tidal Wave
abilities.description: The Tidewitch raises the vault's water and drops it: {0} Frost damage to every enemy within 30 yards, and they are knocked back. It cannot be interrupted.

abilities.name: Call the Tide
abilities.description: The pool boils, and two tide wisps rise to defend their mistress.

abilities.name: Drowning Embrace
abilities.description: Plum tentacles coil round the target: rooted, and Frost damage every 3 sec for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Pearl Mend
abilities.description: The pearl in her staff glows: the Tidewitch heals herself for 10% of her health. It can be interrupted.

abilities.name: High Tide
abilities.description: Below a quarter of her health the Tidewitch becomes the tide: damage dealt increased by 30%.

items.name: Staff of the Undertow
items.description: Driftwood and coral, with a cold pearl caught in the claw. It pulls, faintly, toward deep water.

items.name: Coral Crown of the Tidewitch
items.description: A branching crown of living coral, still growing, very slowly. Healers swear it hums the sending song.

items.name: Tidebreaker
items.description: A sentinel's trident, scoured of barnacles and reforged with the Tidewitch's pearl-bronze. It hits like the sea.

items.name: Kelpwoven Leggings
items.description: Leather braided with dried kelp. They creak like a ship's rigging and fit like a second skin.

items.name: Sentinel's Porthole Helm
items.description: A round bronze helm with a glass porthole visor. The inside has been thoroughly dried. Mostly.

items.name: Robe of the Drowned Choir
items.description: A temple chorister's robe, sea-green and silver. When the wind blows through it, it sings one note, very softly.

items.name: Tidecaller's Ring
items.description: A ring of black pearl that is always cool to the touch, and always, faintly, damp.

items.name: Scale of the Deep
items.description: A Vault Snapjaw's back-plate set in bronze. It has stopped bigger teeth than yours.

items.name: Ossuary's Banner-Cloak
items.description: The drowned temple's last banner, worn by its last captain. The heron on it is faded almost to nothing.

items.name: Barnacled Bracers
items.description: Verdigris bronze, crusted with barnacles that are, somehow, still alive.

items.name: Snapjaw-Hide Gloves
items.description: Pale, supple and blind-white, from a crocolisk that never saw the sun.

items.name: Undertow Signet
items.description: The vault's priests wore these. The sigil is a lantern going down into the waves.

items.name: Tide-Singer's Bracers
items.description: Leather bracers stitched with the old tide-songs, from the vault's chorister vestry. Bloop insists they are rightfully yours.

items.name: Listening Conch
items.description: Bloop's second-best conch. Hold it to your ear in a fight and you can hear, very faintly, which way the tide is turning.

items.name: Sentinel's Verdigris Gauntlets
items.description: Green bronze gauntlets from the vault's gate-guard, scoured clean by mireling sand and a great deal of patience.

items.name: Pearl-Diver's Boots
items.description: Cloth boots with weighted soles, for walking on the bottom of the sea. They work just as well on stairs.

items.name: Clump of Vault Barnacles
items.description: They close up when you touch them. They have been closing up for a hundred years.

items.name: Drowned Temple Coin
items.description: A green bronze coin stamped with a lantern going down into the waves.

items.name: Cold Sea-Glass
items.description: Glass from a lantern that went down the undertow. It is never quite dry.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: *At the edge of the black well the water rises into a slow spiral, and in the spiral floats a woman with a coral crown and kelp for hair, humming. Around her, heaped like driftwood, lie the drowned lanterns of a hundred years. Every one of them is dark.*

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: *She opens her eyes. They are the colour of very deep water.* 'Shh, shh. Little lights go down, down, down. And so will you, my dears. So will you.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: *'My sister sings it to the Heart,' she says dreamily, 'and I sing it to the lights, and the lights sing it all the way down.' She smiles with far too many teeth. 'You'll learn it soon. Everybody does, at the bottom.'*

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: *The spiral of water rears up behind her like a wave about to break.*
